Statutory registry licences, operating subsidiaries and temporary acquisition vehicles remain within the same company boundary.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Teranet Inc. is a Canadian statutory-registry and digital public-service infrastructure platform. It operates Ontario's electronic land-search and registration system and Manitoba's land titles and personal-property registries under long-term contractual arrangements, serving governments, legal professionals, lenders, utilities, businesses and citizens. Teranet reports more than 850 employees, over 10 million annual transactions and more than 200 million registry images. OMERS Infrastructure acquired control in 2008 through a Borealis acquisition vehicle and owns 100% through Teranet Holdings LP. Earlier ownership comprised the Government of Ontario and Teramira consortium, followed by Teranet Income Fund's public structure. Registry data remains government-owned and regulated; operating subsidiaries and acquired service businesses are not separate PortCos. No later sale, exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
